title: ファイアーエムブレム 聖魔の光石
sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on mGBA (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. Snaps were studied outside it
From Fire Emblem: Rekka no Ken (games/gba/AGB-AE7J.lua): the script, the talk's typing word in the CPU's memory (0x03000040, the same here) and the scan for the words the game places in work RAM
Found here, in snaps of one session: where the unpacked message lies (0x0202A6A8 on, so the copies' range was widened), the build table (0x03006470); this game has no tactician, so no name is put in
Played through the map's narration of the continent, the fall of the castle and the escape: one stretch from a state with the script loaded, a press every 300 frames
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 50 of 50 pictures, over 3 scenes (15, 29 and 6); 7 long narration pages said inside a press have no picture. No screen without text was among them
17 harness calls in all (by the record), none failed
notes: Read by the script games/gba/AGB-BE8J.lua: the page the game has unpacked and typed, once it stands at its wait, from the talk's bubbles and the map's narration. Not read: the opening's narration over black before the title's menu returns, menus, choices, fights.
